name: Wenhao Yang
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: An application-oriented HRI/XR mentor with substantive collaborative VLA research and current robot facilities. Particularly suited to interface, robustness or robot-system evaluation projects; the broad lab portfolio also includes nonrobot XR and education work, so a robot-facing AI project should be specified.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full January 2026 TT-VLA manuscript lists Yang at Lamar and reports OpenVLA test-time policy adaptation on a real Franka Research 3 across nine task settings, ten trials each. The campus hosting that Franka is not identified, so this is collaborative hardware evidence, not proof of a Lamar-owned FR3 or local VLA deployment. Separately, the current XRAI lab inventories UR10e and xArm6 manipulators, and the official faculty page describes hands-on UR10e courses. The August 2026 TurtleBot4 inspection project explicitly uses TSP heuristics and Nav2/Dijkstra/DWB, which establish real robot navigation but not a learned controller.

shortVisit.summary: The homepage broadly welcomes motivated students to the research group, but does not identify external-master’s visitors, internships or short visits. The 2026 Lamar SURF article concerns undergraduate projects. Neither is a verified summer 2027 external-master opening.

scoreReasons.fit: 35/40: real VLA methods collaboration and HRI/XR systems, with a broader application/education portfolio than a robot-learning-focused group.
scoreReasons.physical: 20/25: actual collaborative learned FR3 execution; current Lamar hardware independently verified but study provenance/local learned deployment unresolved.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: 0/20: generic student welcome and undergraduate programs do not establish an external-master short visit.
scoreReasons.freshness: 15/15: January 2026 VLA preprint plus August/September 2026 physical lab activity.

The current Lamar J-1 forms index establishes an exchange-visitor process. Its linked sponsor sheet requires dean/chair/sponsor signatures, but no clear external-master research-only eligibility or Student Intern designation was verified.
The linked DS-7002 is a 2018 generic form with a 2021 OMB expiration, under a heading labeled Academic Training; it does not independently establish a current Student Intern program.
Physical VLA experiments are collaborative with campus provenance unresolved; do not equate current Lamar classroom hardware or classical TurtleBot navigation with the TT-VLA experiment.

The official September 2024 CV dates his Lamar assistant professorship to July 2024; his current homepage summarizes the start as Fall 2024. Both support 2024, but the small month/term wording difference is retained.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
